mentions.name: STM32 Nucleo 64 embedded systems learning
mentions.description: A hands-on embedded systems learning project built around an STM32 Nucleo 64 board, guided by the books "Making Embedded Systems" and "Practical Electronics for Inventors". The goal is to learn and practice enough to land a job in embedded systems.
mentions.problem: Workplace mandates to use AI all the time have killed the builder's passion for web development, prompting a switch toward embedded systems.
mentions.source_excerpt:
For this, I'm starting to learn about embedded systems with a STM32 Nucleo 64 board and the books "Making Embedded Systems" and "Practical Electronics for Inventors".

The objective is to learn and practice a lot, so I can land a job in the near future.
